title: NAFAU–Shoprite private-employer wage strike and demonstrations
summary: The strike began on 23 December 2020 and continued through January. NBC/NAMPA says the nationwide strike ran until 22 January; The Namibian later reports it ended in the last week of January after a pay agreement. Informanté’s 17 January report says the NAFAU action planned for 14 January continued Friday and Saturday at Walvis Bay’s Dunes Mall, with police also intervening in Keetmanshoop and Tsumeb. These public phases concern Shoprite/AR activity, store closures or access to private premises; no state-policy demand or local attendance count is reported. A 20 January Afrikaans newspaper search result also notes a Tsumeb Shoprite-worker protest during the strike; the local attendance is not given. Namibian Sun’s 15 January search result also reports community members joining striking employees to close the Tsumeb branch on a Tuesday morning; it provides no local attendance or state-directed demand and does not settle whether this was the same Tsumeb action mentioned in the 20 January Afrikaans issue.
screening_disposition: Not a January-owned MM event on current evidence: wage and allowance demands were directed at private employer Shoprite; regional public actions also concerned shop closures or access to private mall premises. Court proceedings, police presence and reported force do not by themselves create a domestic-state demand. The separate station release request after an activist’s arrest remains in NAM202101_E002 pending threshold and episode review.
notes: Reported workforce and nationwide demonstration totals must not be assigned to a single January gathering. Do not split this December-started strike at the month boundary. NBC gives 22 January as the strike end, while a later report describes a last-week-of-January settlement; neither establishes the physical end of each local demonstration. The Jan 15 Oshakati state-demand phase remains distinct from private wage demands, and later Yetu Complex force is not automatically a response to the station demand. The Namibian Sun and Republikein Tsumeb references may describe different dates or phases; do not infer a single event without follow-up.
